primary_goal: From excellent finished typographic work distill executable author-like shape construction, test unseen glyphs, prove aesthetic merit not just correct SVG or contrast numbers.

source_font.role: Single consistently designed multi-glyph source family, used to infer local terminal/turn shape hypotheses, not as a template font for test chars
source_font.creator_metadata: Ma ShanZheng (Google Fonts attribution), not Kitaoji Rosanjin
source_font.usage_rules: Do not redistribute original TTF; include copyright/OFL attribution where font-software derivative assets are distributed; newly made graphics not judged legally for trademarks.

geometry_source.role: Character stroke centerlines and order; validation must separate target printed skeleton from learned artist style.
geometry_source.license_note: Hanzi Writer data originally made from Arphic typeface; code and dataset rights to be reverified before commercial exploitation.

controls.name: neutral printable skeleton
controls.method: Equal-width all HanziWriter centerlines with round terminals.

controls.name: old global-width proxy (R2)
controls.method: Same centerlines and fixed three visual weight tiers based on length/angle, tapered ends. No glyph-specific source author.

controls.name: source-derived role-conditioned primitives (R5)
controls.method: Same centerlines; learn meaningful caps, local turn profiles and ink distributions from training-only MaShanZheng character pixels, map to new glyph stroke role and layout; no source target font bitmap used during inference.

controls.name: held-out style-font reference (oracle only)
controls.method: Render frozen source font's target codepoints for side-by-side aesthetic diagnosis; NEVER use to derive C before freezing outputs.

explicit_boundaries: Do not treat source font's average pixel contrast as designer's learned process
Do not copy source glyph pixels or pen outlines from target characters into C
Do not infer original handwritten velocity, pressure, stroke order from modern finished font contours
Per-stroke role tags are hypotheses from known pedagogical centerlines and may be wrong; record reliability
Every candidate must use exactly same target glyphs as baselines; no hidden retries/best-of-N
Source C can fail aesthetically; if so preserve negative result and stop rather than tune appearance until pleasing
Confirm actual distinct pixels via SHA256 and exact target codepoints
No commercial/golden promotion or source-font derivative redistribution without license review
Human blind aesthetic pass and legibility pass required before any 'method learned' label.
next: Implement immutable training-only local terminal/turn geometry atlas and submit A/B/C plus D oracle to isolated artifact inspection. If role samples or exact source verification fail, do not claim R5 success.
